description: Performance budget derived from the Phase 4 verified build (2026-08-25). Enforced in CI to prevent regression. The 'baseline' block is the actual measured size; the 'budget' block is baseline + controlled safety margin. Raise the budget only after measured optimization, never to mask a regression.

budget.description: Total JS shipped to the client. Baseline 743 KB + 6% margin (~46 KB).
Total CSS shipped. Baseline 85 KB + 12% margin (~10 KB).
Largest single JS chunk. Baseline 397 KB + 6% margin. The entry chunk (index.js) is the primary candidate for code-splitting regressions.
Largest CSS chunk. Baseline 85 KB + 17% margin. Single CSS file is acceptable for the design system scope.
Maximum number of distinct bundles. Baseline 12 + 50% headroom. More than 18 suggests accidental over-splitting (round-trip cost > savings).
